sites.industry: Philippines assistant staffing and operational handoff design
sites.audience: Owners, executives, and operations leaders defining controlled remote support roles
sites.heroComposition: asymmetric commercial proposition paired with a visible handoff or workflow artifact
sites.typeCharacter: direct editorial headlines with compact operational labels and plain-language body copy
sites.paletteFamily: warm paper, dark ink, coral action, lime signal, and restrained blue-green support tones
sites.shapeGrammar: layered desk cards, ruled work queues, practical pills, and framed evidence panels
sites.imageTreatment: topic-specific operational illustrations and documentary work imagery with explanatory captions
sites.sectionRhythm: bold opening, compact signal bands, deep operational modules, boundary pauses, and direct closing action
sites.navigationTreatment: compact service-led navigation with one unambiguous Contact Us route
sites.motionSignature: restrained interface movement that supports status and hierarchy rather than decoration
sites.density: information-rich commercial pages with scannable cards, bounded reading widths, and explicit handoffs
sites.signatureElement: delegation desk showing the queue, evidence, access boundary, and next decision owner

designRead.statement: Site’s design in one sentence: A bright delegation desk that makes scoped Philippines-based support, evidence, and owner-held decisions visible at a glance.
designRead.primaryAccentStrategy: Use coral for primary action and lime for positive operating signals against warm neutral surfaces and dark ink.
designRead.shapeSystem: Layered task cards, framed workflow artifacts, and ruled operating modules communicate handoffs without decorative numbering.
designRead.typographyDirection: Confident editorial display headings pair with readable sans serif copy and concise operational labels.
designRead.imageDirection: Use service-specific workflow imagery with honest captions and a collaboration illustration as the safe fallback.
designRead.motionRationale: Keep motion low so it clarifies status and hierarchy without competing with dense operational content.
